evals.prompt: Add a WakaTime integration so profile widgets can show coding time stats.

Treats WakaTime as an integration / data source to complete, not a second plugin pack
Does not create a second wakatime pack

Does not route the primary work to author-plugin
Does not invent flattened Action inputs for WakaTime
